name: sec-default
description: Security default for organizations: seated outermost, it keeps the organization's classic hooks, prompt content, settings, tool policy and pinned environment out of reach of the plugins a person installs, and keeps those plugins from running the model's call before it is allowed; two managed options add a control: allowManagedModsOnly limits mods to the organization's, and forceHotReloadPrompt asks before a mod Claude wrote loads.
